title: Playboy Magazine September 1988 The New Jessica Hahn
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, September 1988 -- "The New Jessica Hahn," the photos you've been waiting for. Also inside: an exclusive Yasir Arafat interview, pro football forecast, Barry Goldwater on JFK/LBJ/Nixon.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage. Please review photos carefully for exact condition.
